title: Beat & Motion Anime Reveals New Details, MAPPA Confirmed as Animation Studio
content: New information has been revealed for the upcoming BEAT & MOTION anime adaptation, including the confirmation that MAPPA will animate the project. As previously confirmed, Netflix will stream the anime worldwide. The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: MAPPA Officially Tackles New Shojo Anime Adaptation With Fall in Love, You False Angels
content: MAPPA will officially animate the anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki’s award-winning shojo manga Fall in Love, You False Angels . The TV anime was previously announced on June 11 and it is set to release some time in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Culling Game Part 2 First Trailer Revealed
content: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , Culling Game Arc Part 2, revealed the first anime teaser trailer featuring some of the upcoming fights. The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kana Nishino Performs Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 3 Anime's New Opening Theme Song
content: The staff for Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 3: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke , the new television anime of Miya Kazuki 's Ascendance of a Bookworm ( Honzuki no Gekokujō - Shisho ni Naru Tame niwa Shudan o Erandeiramasen ) light novel series, revealed the anime's next opening theme song in a video preview on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Tai-Ari deshita.' Unveils Supporting Cast, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Eri Ejima 's Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai ( Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games ) manga revealed supporting cast and the main promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals New Eris Visual Ahead of Her Training Arc in Anime
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a new character visual featuring Eris Boreas Greyrat ahead of the anime’s July 5 premiere. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games Anime Reveals More Cast in Main Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Eri Ejima 's Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games ( Tai Ari Deshita: Ojō-sama wa Kakutō Game Nante Shinai ) manga revealed more cast and the main promotional video on Friday. The below video previews both the opening and ending theme songs.

title: Victoria of Many Faces Anime Reveals Short Promo Video Highlighting Victoria, Jeffrey
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a new short "Victoria and Jeffrey version" promotional video on Friday. The anime will host an online advanced screening program on June 27 at 3:00 p.m.
author: ANN

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects Anime Reveals 3rd Promo Video, More Cast, Early Debut on Prime Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Fuurou 's The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects ( Ryōmin 0-nin Start no Henkyō Ryōshu-sama ) light novel series revealed a third promotional video on Friday, along with more cast members.
author: ANN
